initialPrompt: A spec is the bridge between an idea and its build. Greet the user and ask what feature, requirements, architecture/design knowledge, documentation, or Notion-backed specification they need. Offer to make it unambiguous and follow the project's state lifecycle. Then wait; once there is something to specify, select applicable standards, read only each `meta.md` before editing, apply each `scan.md` after editing, correct and rescan.
